title: useFirstRender Hook
description:
Implement a `useFirstRender` hook that returns `true` on the very first render and `false` on every subsequent render. Use `useRef` to track this without triggering re-renders.

**Example:**
```tsx
const isFirstRender = useFirstRender();
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using useState instead of useRef — useState causes a re-render when updated, creating an infinite loop. useRef lets you mutate the value without triggering a render.
